context: The RV32/RV64 Zicsr and RV32M standard extension instruction encodings include CSRRW, CSRRS, CSRRC, CSRRWI, CSRRSI, CSRRCI, MUL, MULH, MULHSU, MULHU, DIV, DIVU, REM, REMU, MULW, DIVW, DIVUW, REMW, and REMUW with their respective opcode and funct3 field values.
